name: Kishida Momoka
source:
The wife of the newly-wed couple living next door to the protagonist.
She's a very bright and cheerful woman, though somewhat of an airhead.
She looks kind, always wearing that carefree smile on her face.
Albeit her face might appear child-like, however, she's got a voluptuous body, especially those huge breasts of hers.
With the exception of her husband, Momoka doesn't have any sexual experience.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.miel-soft.com/tonarinookusan.html]Official Site[/url]].
